name: ipgeolocation-io-mcp
description: Official MCP server for IP geolocation, company information, ASN and network data, IP security, abuse contacts, time zones, astronomy, currency data and user-agent parsing.
long_description: The official IPGeolocation.io MCP server provides 17 tools for accurate IP geolocation, company information, ASN and network data, IP security (VPN, proxy, Tor, bot, hosting and spam detection), abuse contacts, time zones, astronomy, currency data and user-agent parsing. It runs locally over stdio on Node.js 22 or later. Most tools need an API key; data access and credits depend on your plan. Large results use cached pages when they fit in the cache, so you can read the rest without another API call. Saved pages require the same server process and API key and can expire. See README.md for setup and REFERENCE.md for tool and configuration details.

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Geolocation for a public IPv4/IPv6 address; domain lookup requires a paid plan

tools.name: bulk_lookup_ip
tools.description: Bulk IP geolocation, up to 250 inputs per MCP request by default

tools.name: get_my_ip
tools.description: Returns the public egress IP of the machine running this server

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Company details and ASN ownership for an IP; free plans return basic ASN only

tools.name: lookup_currency
tools.description: Currency and country metadata for a public IP address

tools.name: lookup_network
tools.description: BGP route prefix, connection type, and anycast indicator

tools.name: check_security
tools.description: IP security indicators, including VPN, proxy, Tor, bot flags, and threat scores

tools.name: bulk_security_check
tools.description: Bulk security check, up to 250 inputs per MCP request by default

tools.name: get_timezone
tools.description: Timezone lookup by IANA name, coordinates, IP, or airport code

tools.name: get_astronomy
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, twilight, and moon phases

tools.name: get_astronomy_time_series
tools.description: Daily astronomy data for a date range up to 90 days

tools.name: parse_user_agent
tools.description: Parse a user-agent string into device, browser, OS details

tools.name: bulk_parse_user_agent
tools.description: Bulk parse up to 250 user-agent strings per MCP request by default

tools.name: lookup_asn
tools.description: ASN details with optional peers, upstreams, downstreams, routes, and WHOIS

tools.name: get_abuse_contact
tools.description: Abuse contact email, phone, and address for a public IP

tools.name: get_cached_result
tools.description: Read or replay a cached JSON page with the same process and API key; no API call or credits

credentials.justification: Authenticate IP intelligence, time zone, astronomy, ASN, abuse, and user-agent lookups, which can consume API credits. The server keeps the key in process memory without writing it to disk or refreshing it. The client or host controls its own credential storage.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your IPGeolocation.io API key. Get a free key at https://app.ipgeolocation.io/signup

request_timeout_ms.title: Request timeout (ms)
request_timeout_ms.description: Time limit for an API request, including reading its response.

cache_ttl_ms.title: Cache TTL (ms)
cache_ttl_ms.description: How long results stay cached. Reading a cached page restarts its expiry timer.

cache_max_entries.title: Maximum cache entries
cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of stored responses and page snapshots. The cache size limit also applies.

max_bulk_items.title: Maximum bulk items
max_bulk_items.description: Maximum inputs in a bulk request. The lower of this setting and Maximum result items sets the batch limit.

max_result_items.title: Maximum result items
max_result_items.description: Maximum results in a bulk request. The lower of this setting and Maximum bulk items sets the batch limit. Arrays within a result stay complete.

max_response_chars.title: Maximum response bytes
max_response_chars.description: Maximum size of a tool reply in bytes. Larger results use cached pages when they fit in the cache. Results that cannot be stored can fail after using API credits. Error messages may be shortened.

max_error_chars.title: Maximum error characters
max_error_chars.description: Maximum length of an error message. The reply size limit can shorten it further.

cache_max_bytes.title: Maximum cache bytes
cache_max_bytes.description: Maximum size of stored cache data in bytes. This does not limit total memory use. A result that cannot fit may be returned without caching; large results that need saved pages can fail after using credits.

upstream_max_response_bytes.title: Maximum upstream response bytes
upstream_max_response_bytes.description: Maximum size of a successful API response in bytes, after decompression. A larger response fails and may already have used credits.

max_argument_bytes.title: Maximum tool argument bytes
max_argument_bytes.description: Maximum size of tool inputs in bytes. Larger inputs are rejected before an API request.
